waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it.

mutations.name: no-keep
mutations.why: The open sends before anything is kept (v0.134.0).
mutations.search: /\ kept' = IF Keep THEN [at |-> None, there |-> TRUE] ELSE kept

mutations.name: settle-on-hand
mutations.why: The entry goes once the omp took the prompt, not once it journaled it: a quit in between loses it.
mutations.search: /\ kept' = IF kept.there THEN [kept EXCEPT !.at = omp] ELSE kept

mutations.name: no-instance
mutations.why: The sweep hands the message to the omp that already holds it.

mutations.name: ignore-journal
mutations.why: The sweep never asks the journal: a relaunch's omp gets a message the old one already journaled.

mutations.name: no-lane
mutations.why: The sweep runs while the open is still sending (no receiver lane): both hand it over.

mutations.name: no-relaunch-fairness
mutations.why: Nothing makes the app start again after a quit.
